name: A quick turn is routine
case: The agent starts a turn and finishes it seconds later, with nothing else happening. Boop is happy. It doesn't react to the start, and at most gives the quick finish a small happy face, with no cheer. Its mood stays happy.
why: harness/DECISIONS.md §2.2: boop stays quiet during routine work; a short turn start or finish is nothing to mumble about, and the mood stays happy: a routine turn start is no reason to leave it (plan/steering/mood/happy.md). A face, if any, holds once: the usual (§3)
